`s3presign.Runner` is the component that refreshes stale links. It re-presigns S3 attachment URLs before expiration.

EXTERNAL attachments are user-provided static links, not S3 objects. The S3 runner refreshes S3-stored attachments. I am checking s3.go to confirm the 5-day presign expiration and verify no other runner handles attachments.

The memopayload runner is unrelated to attachment staleness.

The `s3presign` Runner keeps S3 attachment links from going stale. It runs every 12 hours via `CheckAndPresign`. The component is in the `s3presign` package. It is wired into server startup in `server.go` at line 123.

It also runs once immediately at startup via `RunOnce(ctx)` before the ticker loop begins.

The full wiring path is:

- `cmain.go:89` calls `s.Start(ctx)`
- `server/server.go:129` invokes `s.startBackgroundRunners(ctx)`
- `server/server.go:153-174` instantiates the runner, calls `RunOnce`, and launches the background goroutine
